entries.label: Front lobby
entries.note: Facing the surface lot: a glass vestibule with a day-shift receptionist and no guard after 6 pm.

entries.label: Loading door
entries.note: A single grade-level roll-up door by the dumpsters. The lock is a padlock.

entries.label: Parking deck walkway
entries.note: A covered walkway from the second level of the parking deck behind the building. Badge reader, no camera.

entries.label: Rear stair exit
entries.note: A stair door onto the back lot. Propped open on smoke breaks.

entries.label: Roof hatch
entries.note: A ladder hatch beside the rooftop units, reached from the sixth-floor janitor's closet.
